claim: In the HWA laboratory, a job stream defined with PROMPT "Continue?" (inline text) was submitted and remained in HOLD with the dependent job also HOLD, confirming that a prompt blocks the stream until replied. The reply command requires a named prompt (1-8 bytes); an inline text prompt did not expose a reply name via conman reply.
supporting_quote: PROMPT_TEST remained HOLD; reply reported AWSBHU712E prompt name must be 1-8 bytes.
notes: Prompts block execution until resolved. A named prompt object is required for conman reply.
